dimensions.K: <=4 first protocol; explicit max_slots extension for boundary tests
dimensions.V: fixed model logit support, checked against tokenizer; may include padded rows

old_hidden.meaning: 整个选中集合的目标对齐H0；调用方按DreamOn真实预测位置对齐，本模块不shift

chain_ids.meaning: 链编号，结构屏障和间隔reset

selected_mask.meaning: 有效普通槽位；屏障槽位不入集合

query_indices.meaning: 要修正的目标在选中集合中的槽位

old_logits.meaning: 这些目标的旧分数，仅adapter相加/采样时必需，可为null

token_ids.meaning: 记录或猜测；不可见值不用于判断可见性

history_mask.meaning: 该query可读的同链更早有效槽位；不能靠padding/token值推断可见性

semantics: whole selected set frozen old_hidden/coordinates/chains/valid mask must be retained
old_hidden is already target-aligned by A; repository previous-position convention is not applied a second time
no reference answers, tests, passed flags, or future actual tokens
history is explicit, same chain, strictly earlier, valid, committed ordinary tokens
provisional is only readable by explicit H3/H4 Jacobi mode; never teacher committed or actual A generation
no-history anchor has exactly zero correction; zero_override exactly zeros latent and delta including biases
special token candidates cause structural barrier; excluded from ordinary history
fixed selected-set summary is masked mean of old h only; no token guesses
full-set old h may affect H4 fixed summary; future token identities may not affect earlier queries
no persistent case/chain/round state; reset returns a new explicit prefix
cross-gap mode explicit and OFF by default
Jacobi equivalence limited to ordinary support, fixed old information, fixed selected set, deterministic sampler and fixed per-position u
A must validate provisional structural-candidate scheduling and pre-barrier prefixes separately before full generation

interfaces.step: same, Q=1; prefix explicit; H2 state rebuilt from supplied history
interfaces.reset: head.reset(batch, chain_id=None) -> cleared HeadBatch; geometry unchanged; A supplies new geometry after edits

configuration.special_token_ids: explicit immutable tuple; full tokenizer set for new common heads; legacy mapping must use old output mask
configuration.tokenizer_size: len(tokenizer), excludes padded logit rows from ordinary sampling
configuration.default_init: seed=20261015, E/W normal std .02, shared random values, H1 gamma final linear zero
configuration.legacy_init: historical head had E normal std1 and W_out zero; loaded only for compatibility, never unequal initialization for candidates
